post.summary: Mass create events from issues (admin only)
post.description:
Admin bulk force-conversion of OPEN issues into scheduled events. Accepts
up to 50 issue identifiers (slug or UUID) in a single call. Each issue
is processed independently with the same semantics as the single-issue
`POST /issues/{id}/convert-to-event` endpoint:
- Promotes the issue from `OPEN` → `EVENT_SCHEDULED`.
- Creates the linked Event row, picking the leader from `WANT_TO_LEAD`
  voters (single candidate → leader; none → falls back to the issue
  reporter; multiple → opens a leader-voting round).
- Fires a fire-and-forget voter SMS notification per converted issue.

Per-item failures (issue not found, not in OPEN state, etc.) are
captured in `results` rather than aborting the whole batch.

get.summary: Get the current leader-voting state for an event
get.description:
Public read. Returns the leader-voting status, the candidates (with
live vote counts), the voting deadline, and the resolved leader (if
any). Status values:
- `NONE` — no voting (single WANT_TO_LEAD candidate, or fell back to
  the issue reporter). `eventLeader` is set.
- `OPEN` — voting in progress until `closesAt`.
- `PENDING_ADMIN` — voting closed with a tie; admin must pick from
  the listed candidates before `adminTieBreakClosesAt`.
- `CLOSED` — voting resolved. `eventLeader` is set.

accepted for backward compatibility.

post.summary: Settle leader voting once its deadline has passed
post.description:
Time-driven finalizer. Safe to call repeatedly — mutates state only
when a deadline has actually passed. Intended to be hit by a cron job
or admin tooling.
- From `OPEN` past `closesAt`: tallies votes; sets `CLOSED` with the
  winning leader, or `PENDING_ADMIN` if there is a tie (and starts
  the admin tie-break window).
- From `PENDING_ADMIN` past `adminTieBreakClosesAt`: randomly picks
  one of the tied candidates and closes voting.

Requires a verified user. To attach photos, pre-upload them via
`/uploads/presign` + PUT + `/uploads/{id}/confirm`, then pass the
resulting upload IDs in `uploadIds`. The uploads must be owned by
the caller, confirmed, and not yet attached to another issue.

The server automatically resolves the `provinceId` and `districtId`
based on the provided `latitude` and `longitude` coordinates using
an offline Nepal administrative boundaries map. If the coordinates
fall outside Nepal, the request fails with `COORDINATES_OUTSIDE_NEPAL`.

The response includes a server-generated `slug` derived from the
English title (kebab-case, unique). The slug is immutable once
created — subsequent title edits do not change it, so frontend
deep-links stay stable.

post.summary: Mass create issues (admin only)
post.description:
Admin bulk-import endpoint. Accepts up to 25 issue payloads in a single
request and processes each independently — translation failures,
upload-attach errors, and per-row DB errors are captured per-item and
reported in the response, rather than aborting the whole batch.

Per-item semantics:
- Each item follows the same shape as `POST /issues`.
- `coverImageId` and any `uploadIds` must be owned by the calling
  admin (the importer), confirmed, and not yet attached.
- `reportedById` (optional) attributes the issue to the given user; if
  omitted, the issue is attributed to the calling admin.
- Each item gets its own server-generated `slug` (derived from the
  English title), the same way single-create does.

The response contains a `results` array (ordered by request index) and
a `summary` of how many succeeded vs. failed.

post.summary: Upvote an issue
post.description:
Requires a verified user. One vote per user per issue (enforced at
DB level). Promotion is driven by `attendingCount` — the number of
votes with `voterRole` `GOING` or `WANT_TO_LEAD` (`INTERESTED` votes
are excluded). When `attendingCount` reaches the issue's
`conversionThreshold` (reporter-set, default 10), the issue status
flips to `EVENT_SCHEDULED` and an SMS is dispatched to all voters.

Commitment level the voter is signing up for. Used later
to assign roles when the issue converts to an event.

The participant role this voter signs up to take at the

must be **omitted** for `INTERESTED` / `WANT_TO_LEAD`. On
conversion to an event, GOING voters with a role here are
auto-added as CONFIRMED participants (unverified `MEDIC`
picks are skipped — MEDIC needs credential verification).

get.summary: Get the full admin analytics report (admin only)
get.description:
Returns a single aggregated report covering all admin-panel domains:
overview KPIs, users, issues, events, engagement (votes), feedback,
participation applications, uploads, and geographic distribution.

## Date range
Optional `fromDate` / `toDate` filter the "period" counts and the time
series; lifetime counts always reflect the active filters but ignore
the date range. When both dates are provided the previous equal-length
period is auto-computed and used to produce `overview.deltaPercent`.

## Bucketing
Time series are auto-bucketed:
- `<= 31 days` → daily
- `<= 180 days` → weekly
- otherwise (or no range) → monthly

Pass `bucket` to override the auto-pick.

## Section selection
Pass `sections` as a CSV (e.g. `sections=overview,issues,events`) to
compute only the listed sections — useful for narrow dashboards or
reducing query load. Omit to return everything.

## Advanced filtering
Each filter narrows the section it belongs to. The overview totals
and period counts also respect every active filter, so the response
stays internally consistent.

Filter groups:
- **Geographic** (issues, events, geographic): `municipality`, `ward`
- **Users**: `userRole`, `userVerified`, `userIsOAuth`
- **Issues**: `issueStatus`, `issueCategory`
- **Events**: `eventStatus`, `eventRiskLevel`, `eventLeaderVotingStatus`
- **Engagement (issue votes)**: `voterRole` (+ issue filters propagate)
- **Feedback**: `feedbackType`, `feedbackStatus`
- **Applications**: `applicationRole`, `applicationStatus`
- **Uploads**: `uploadFileType`, `uploadIsConfirmed`, `uploadLinkedTo`

Top-N lists (top voted issues, top leaders, top contributors,
upcoming events) are sized by `topN` (default 10, max 50).

## Example queries
- Last 30 days, daily buckets:
  `?fromDate=2026-04-27T00:00:00Z&toDate=2026-05-27T00:00:00Z`
- OPEN roadside issues in Pokhara only:
  `?issueStatus=OPEN&issueCategory=ROADSIDE&municipality=Pokhara%20Metropolitan%20City`
- Just the events + uploads sections:
  `?sections=events,uploads`
- Completed events with risk URGENT, weekly buckets:
  `?eventStatus=COMPLETED&eventRiskLevel=URGENT&bucket=week`
- Confirmed image uploads orphaned from entities:
  `?uploadFileType=IMAGE&uploadIsConfirmed=true&uploadLinkedTo=orphan`

get.summary: Get the public community-impact report (any signed-in user)
get.description:
A curated, community-facing subset of the admin report. Designed for
general users — it surfaces transparency-style stats (community size,
issues raised, events run, votes cast, geographic distribution) while
omitting anything internal:

Excluded sections / fields (vs. admin report):
- `feedback`, `applications`, `uploads` sections
- Per-user `email` in `topContributors`
- `byRole` user breakdown, `oauth` / `native` counts
- `overview.previousPeriod` and `overview.deltaPercent`

## Sections (CSV via `sections`)
- `overview` — community totals + period counts (users/issues/events/votes)
- `community` — community size, verified %, new-joins time series, top
  contributors (by issues reported, votes cast, events led)
- `issues` — totals, by status/category/municipality, top voted,
  time series
- `events` — totals, by status/risk, upcoming, attendance, top leaders,
  time series
- `engagement` — issue votes + leader votes (totals + series)
- `geographic` — issues/events distribution by municipality + ward

Date range, bucket selection, and `topN` behave identically to the
admin report. See `/api/v1/reports` for details.

Filters supported:
- `municipality`, `ward`
- `issueStatus`, `issueCategory`
- `eventStatus`, `eventRiskLevel`, `eventLeaderVotingStatus`
- `voterRole`
